$comment: Single source of truth for the 2026-07-08 datachain-id-sso handover kickoff.
Both kickoff.ts (SDK) and kickoff.sh (cursor-agent CLI) read this file.
GOAL: every ecosystem platform integrates Datachain ID (https://id.datachain.network)
end-to-end: front-end sign-in (credentials via /v1/auth/login and/or wallet via
/v1/auth/wallet), token storage + session resume, and back-end verification
The handover .mdc is already present in EVERY target workspace at
so each workspace's agent sees the full contract on session start even without
this dispatcher. The dispatcher exists to actively drive the work instead of
waiting for each workspace to be opened manually.
Reference consumer (already live): dcscan.io Connect-Wallet modal
Deploy commands below are carried over verbatim from the audited 2026-05-10
Per LESSONS.md §Migration step 5, re-audit any deploy_command that may have been

workspaces.name: tanastok
actions: Accept Datachain ID Bearer tokens on API routes: verify offline with jose (createRemoteJWKSet against https://id.datachain.network/.well-known/jwks.json, issuer https://id.datachain.network, audience datachain-ecosystem) per handover §Option A.
Map token `sub` to tanastok_users.auth_user_id (same Supabase GoTrue id) so existing accounts resolve without migration.

Add 'Sign in with Datawallet+' to the site auth UI: email+password form POSTing to /v1/auth/login AND wallet path via personal_sign of 'DATACHAIN-ID-AUTH\n{address_lowercase}\n{timestamp}' POSTed to /v1/auth/wallet.
Gate Private-Pool gain-withdrawal actions on amr containing 'wallet_signature' (proof of key possession) per handover §Tanastok note.
Freeze (stop advertising) the bespoke /api/auth/datawallet/verify endpoint in favor of Datachain ID; keep it responding for old callers but mark deprecated.

Source contains a string match for 'DATACHAIN-ID-AUTH' (wallet-path message tag) or 'datachain-ecosystem' (audience check)
deploy_signals: https://tanastok.io serves HTTP 200 AND its shipped JS/HTML bundle references 'id.datachain.network' (curl the login page / main chunk and grep)
workspaces.deploy_command_notes: Audited 2026-05-10 (canonical-agents rollout). Blue-green zero-downtime: reads /opt/tanastok/deploy-state/active-slot, deploys to inactive slot, health-checks, switches nginx, stops old slot. Built locally first (Next.js production build, ~1 GB output), then rsync to VPS. Disk: needs ~5 GiB free (ENOSPC at 4 GiB on 2026-05-10). Use --maintenance ONLY for intentional downtime.
workspaces.primer_extra: Tanastok already shares the same Supabase project as Datawallet+, so token `sub` IS the GoTrue user id already stored in tanastok_users.auth_user_id — the identity mapping is a lookup, not a migration. Do not touch the Private-Pool payout/settlement logic itself; only add the amr gate in front of the withdrawal request handler.

workspaces.name: dcswap
actions: Add a 'Sign in with Datawallet+' entry next to the existing wallet-connect flow in public/app.js (or the current frontend entry point), using the wallet path: personal_sign of 'DATACHAIN-ID-AUTH\n{address_lowercase}\n{timestamp}' POSTed to https://id.datachain.network/v1/auth/wallet per handover §DCSwap note.
Store the returned token + user object; render a signed-in pill (truncated primary_address); local-decode exp for session resume; clear on disconnect (mirror the dcscan-wallet.js reference behavior).
Where the indexer/API keys any per-user data (prefs, watchlists), key it on token `sub` and verify tokens server-side via /v1/auth/introspect or offline jose verify.

workspaces.name: datawallet-web
actions: Add ecosystem SSO sign-in on datawallet.io: email+password form POSTing to https://id.datachain.network/v1/auth/login, plus the wallet-signature path where an injected provider is present.

After sign-in, render the session (name/email + truncated primary_address from the token's user object) and surface 'Your Datawallet+ account now signs you in across the Datachain ecosystem' messaging.
Verify tokens client-side by calling GET /v1/auth/userinfo with the Bearer token on page load for session resume.

workspaces.name: datawallet-rn
actions: Surface 'Sign in to ecosystem sites with your Datawallet+ account' in the app (settings or profile screen) explaining that the same credentials work on dcscan.io, dcswap.net, tanastok.io, etc., per handover §Datawallet+ note.

Add a service module that exchanges the user's credentials (or an in-app personal_sign with the active wallet key) for a Datachain ID token via /v1/auth/login or /v1/auth/wallet, so in-app webviews / deep links can be pre-authenticated.
Handle the wallet path in-app: sign 'DATACHAIN-ID-AUTH\n{address_lowercase}\n{timestamp}' with the local wallet key (no password prompt) and POST to /v1/auth/wallet.
